Name: Sun Haven Animated Hair Pack (Male)
Author: FrutigerAero101
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Add some Sun Haven hairstyles to your game[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=4]1. Download and install *SMAPI* and *Fashion Sense*
2. Download this mod and extract the RAR file.
3. Copy the extracted folder and paste it into the *Local Pack - hairs* folder inside your Fashion Sense.[/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Add 12 new hairstyles for your character (FS)[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Fashion Sense[/color][/size]
